title: Aelix Analytics record contract: analytics.project/2, analytics.event/2, analytics.report_revision/1, analytics.publication/1, analytics.run/2, analytics.dataset/1, analytics.trust/1, analytics.migration/1
description: ADR-0006 (docs/decisions/0006-common-record-contract.md), adopted 2026-10-03; analytics.run/2, analytics.dataset/1 and analytics.trust/1 from the record writer design (docs/design/RECORD-WRITER-AND-MIGRATION.md 2.6 and 2.7, OQ5). Kit 0.7.0 (Issue #13 PR 1) reads analytics.run/2 runs and analytics.dataset/1 import records under data/imported/, and lists analytics.event/2 records; kit 0.8.0 (Issue #13 PR 3) writes analytics.project/2, analytics.event/2, analytics.run/2, analytics.dataset/1 and the trust list analytics.trust/1 (outside the project). analytics.migration/1 is the copy migration's plan, mapping and report (design 2.7 and 6.3-6.8, Issue #13 PR 2), told apart by `record`: the migration engine writes them, analytics.project/2's optional `migration` binds the report by its sha256, and a migration's ledger lines (progress.jsonl, named by its plan) carry no family tag: migration_progress_line is their shape. Fields the contract does not name are allowed so that a reader keeps the optional fields a later writer adds. Kinds, reference types, relations, bases and bindings are closed: a reader reports a value outside them as unsupported and keeps the record. Rules a schema cannot state are in the ADR: Report file paths in NFC and distinct under casefold (section 7), request_id compared without case (section 8), the record_update transitions (section 6) and the digest of a reference equal to the hash its target record holds (section 3).

migration.description: On a project a migration made (design 2.4): the report it wrote, bound by its sha256. A writer that writes the marker again keeps it as it is (design 4.8).

trust_1.description: The trust list (design 2.7 and 6.14): the project roots a person or an agent created or chose, which starting aelix inside them activates. Outside every project (analytics-projects.json in the host's agent directory, or AELIX_ANALYTICS_TRUST_FILE).

migration_progress_line.description: A line of a migration's ledger, progress.jsonl (design 6.8): appended only, each written before what it names is made. A line that does not parse is a cut-off append and is skipped.
